auth.subtitle: Plan meals and track macros
auth.waitingForBrowser: Finish signing in in your browser…

settings.title: Settings
settings.targetsDescription: Used in the plan's day summaries and on the home screen.
settings.impliedKcal: These macros give about {{kcal}} kcal (4 / 9 / 4 kcal per gram).
settings.mealSlotsDescription: Order and names of the meals in your plan. They are also your recipe categories. Hidden meals are not shown in the plan but keep their history.
settings.deleteSlotDescription: Only a meal that has never been used in the plan can be deleted. You can hide a meal that is in use.
settings.slotInUse: This meal is used in your plan – hide it instead of deleting.
settings.productCategoriesDescription: Put the categories in the order of the aisles in your shop – the shopping list follows this order. Fixed categories are shared by everyone; your own can only be used for your private products.
settings.deleteProductCategoryDescription: Products in this category will be moved to “Inne” (other).
settings.proteinHint: About 0.8–0.9 g/kg body weight covers basic needs; 1.4–2.0 g/kg when active or reducing weight.
settings.fatHint: EFSA and the Polish nutrition standards: 20–35% of energy. WHO advises no more than 30%.
settings.fatRangeInvalid: The minimum cannot be above the maximum
settings.carbsNone: Protein and fat use up the calorie limit.
settings.householdDescription: How many people you cook this plan for. Shopping list amounts are multiplied by this; the plan, summaries and goals are per person.

validation.ean: Invalid EAN (8, 12, 13 or 14 digits with a valid check digit)
validation.macrosOver100: Protein, fat and carbs add up to more than 100 g

plan.addDescription: Search for a recipe or product and enter the amount. The dialog stays open so you can add more.
plan.archived: Removed from your products or recipes
plan.replaceDescription: The current items are removed and replaced with the copied ones.
plan.dragHint: Drag to move · hold Ctrl to copy

share.title: Share the plan
share.description: Copy the plan as text and send it to someone for review.
share.heading: Meal plan {{range}}

fit.remaining: Left for today: {{kcal}} kcal · P {{protein}} g

recipes.name: Name
recipes.shareNote: The recipe appears in other users' Inspiration with your name and picture. The names and nutrition values of your private products used in it become visible too.
recipes.noProductsYet: You have no products yet – add them on the Products screen.
recipes.noIngredients: Add ingredients from your product list.
recipes.gramsInvalid: Enter an amount for every ingredient (more than 0, max {{max}} g).
recipes.archivedProduct: This product was removed from your list
recipes.unsavedDescription: You have unsaved changes in this recipe.
recipes.sharedToast: The recipe is now visible in Inspiration
recipes.unshared: The recipe is no longer shared
recipes.deleteDescription: The recipe disappears from your list and from Inspiration. Plans that used it keep it.
recipes.empty: You have no recipes yet. Create one or save something from Inspiration.
recipes.noSharedYet: Nobody has shared a recipe yet.
recipes.copyNote: The saved copy is independent of the original.
recipes.alreadyCopiedTitle: You already have a copy of this recipe
recipes.alreadyCopiedDescription: Your recipes contain “{{name}}”. Save another copy?

md.title: Formatting (Markdown)
md.heading: heading
md.blankLine: An empty line starts a new paragraph.

products.name: Name
products.empty: You have no products yet. Add one manually, from an EAN code or from the catalog.
products.privateNote: Private product – visible only to you.
products.duplicateNote: Copy as a private product – you can change the values.
products.manualFromOffNote: Open Food Facts has incomplete data. Fill in the missing fields – the product will be saved as private.
products.manualNotFoundNote: The product was not found in Open Food Facts. Enter the data manually – it will be saved as private.
products.removeDescription: The product stays in the shared catalog and you can add it again.
products.deleteDescription: The product disappears from your list. Recipes and plans that used it keep it.
products.eanTitle: Add a product from an EAN code
products.eanDescription: We look the product up in the catalog and in Open Food Facts.
products.foundInCatalog: This product is already in the shared catalog.
products.alreadyInList: This product is already in your list.
products.catalogCategoryNote: The product goes into the shared catalog, so it needs a fixed category.
products.importToCatalog: Add to catalog and my list
products.imported: Product added to the catalog and your list
products.offIncomplete: Open Food Facts has incomplete data for this product (missing name or macros).
products.offNotFound: No product with this code was found in Open Food Facts.
products.catalogDescription: Products added from EAN codes by all users.
products.catalogMark: Shared catalog (added from an EAN code)
products.nameEditNote: You can correct the name – all catalog users will see it. Nutrition values come from Open Food Facts.

setup.missingEnvBody: Copy .env.example to .env and fill in VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.

shopping.localNote: Lists are saved on this computer only.
shopping.noMeals: There are no planned meals in this period.
shopping.selectHint: Untick meals you don't need to shop for.
shopping.outdated: The plan has changed since this list was made.
shopping.copyKeepHint: One product per line, no headings, without bought items – paste into a new Google Keep list.
shopping.copiedKeep: Copied – paste into a Google Keep list (checkboxes)
shopping.personsChanged: The number of people changed ({{from}} → {{to}}). Refresh the list to recalculate amounts.

errors.offline: No internet connection. Data reloads once you're back online.
errors.loadFailed: Couldn't load data from the server.
